datasetVersion.versionNote: The Python package langdetect was used to semi-automatically identify the languages used in the metadata. Human curators verified and corrected the results. If you notice any inaccuracies, please contact DANS.

dsDescriptionValue.value: The Topic-Focus Database gives information about the ways in which languages give formal expression to information-structural categories such as Topic, Focus and Contrast, and their many subtypes. Expression strategies considered include syntactic, morphological and prosodic means of indicating the informational status of a constituent. A further parameter considered concerns the nature of the targeted constituent.
